info.title: Wakeel API
info.description:
Wakeel's API lets your own system (CRM, ERP, online shop, custom app) send WhatsApp messages, run OTP
verification, read and answer the conversations of your inbox, keep contacts in sync and follow tickets.

واجهة وكيل تتيح لنظامك (CRM أو ERP أو متجر أو تطبيق) إرسال رسائل واتساب، والتحقق برمز OTP، وقراءة محادثات
صندوق الوارد والرد عليها، ومزامنة جهات الاتصال، ومتابعة التذاكر.

## Authentication
Create a key on the dashboard page **API Keys**. Send it with every request:

```
Authorization: Bearer sk_your_api_key
```

A key acts as the account owner: it reaches every number and every conversation of the account. Keep it on
your server, never in a browser or mobile app. A dashboard login token (JWT) is accepted on the same
endpoints, with that person's permissions.

## Numbers (channels)
An account can have several numbers: QR-connected numbers (the WhatsApp app scanned a code) and Meta Cloud
API numbers. `GET /api/v1/channels` lists them. Sending endpoints take an optional `channelId`; without it,
the message goes out from the QR-connected number. Meta Cloud numbers must be named with `channelId`.

## Responses and errors
Success answers are JSON with `"success": true`. Failures carry an HTTP status and one of two bodies:
`{"error": {"message": "...", "code": "..."}}` (the `code` is present for some cases, e.g.
`REPLY_WINDOW_CLOSED`, `CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED`), or `{"error": "..."}` for field validation.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 400 | A field is missing or invalid, or the action is not possible now |
| 401 | Missing or invalid key |
| 402 | The plan's monthly message limit is reached |
| 403 | The account is disabled, the feature is not in the plan, or the number is not yours |
| 404 | Not found |
| 429 | Rate limit: 30 messages per minute to one recipient; 3 OTPs per 15 minutes to one phone. Headers X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset and Retry-After say when to retry |

## Webhooks (Wakeel calling you)
On the dashboard page **Developer Tools** set a Webhook URL to receive customer messages and delivery
statuses, and a CRM base URL + token for contact and ticket sync. The payloads are described at the end of
this document under **Webhooks**.

crmClientId.description: The customer's id in your CRM

post.description: Resolves the ticket. Unless `sendRating` is false, the customer gets the rating request configured in Ticket settings.
Gives the ticket to a team member (`assignedToId`), or to nobody (null).

post.summary: A customer wrote to one of your Meta Cloud numbers
post.description:
POSTed to your Webhook URL (Developer Tools) for each message a customer sends to a **Meta Cloud** number, unless incoming messages are turned off there. The body is the message exactly as Meta's Cloud API delivers it (one message per call); `metadata.phone_number_id` says which number received it, `contacts[0].profile.name` the customer's WhatsApp name, `messages[0].from` their phone. Messages to QR-connected numbers are not forwarded. Answer 200 within 5 seconds; a failed delivery is not retried.

Authentication: the header you configured in Developer Tools (name and value), otherwise `X-Webhook-Key: <your API token>` when a CRM token is set.

post.summary: Delivery status of a message you sent from a Meta Cloud number
post.description: POSTed to your Webhook URL when Meta reports `sent`, `delivered`, `read` or `failed` for a message of a Meta Cloud number, unless statuses are turned off in Developer Tools. Same envelope as incoming messages, with `statuses` instead of `messages`; `statuses[0].id` is the `metaMessageId` returned when you sent it. A `failed` status carries Meta's `errors`.

post.summary: A new customer: create or find them in your CRM
post.description: Sent when a message goes to, or comes from, a phone that is new to the account. If a **CRM Base URL** and token are set in Developer Tools, Wakeel instead POSTs `{ "phone", "name" }` to `<CRM Base URL>/api/v1/integrations/provider/sync-contact` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and expects `{ "client_id": "...", "is_new": true|false }` back; the `client_id` is then stored on the conversation and sent with its tickets. Otherwise this event goes to the Webhook URL and your reply may carry `client_id` too.

200.description: Optional: the customer's id in your system

post.summary: A ticket was opened, resolved or closed
post.description: Sent to the Webhook URL when a ticket changes state, with the conversation and customer it belongs to. `status` is `open`, `resolved` or `closed`. If your reply contains a ticket id, Wakeel keeps it as the ticket's `crmTicketId`.

post.summary: The customer rated a closed ticket
post.description: Sent to the Webhook URL when the customer answers the rating request after a ticket is closed. `rating` is 1 to 5.
